items.title: Hold a Billings business license
items.description: Anyone doing business in or based in Billings must hold a city business license on or before the day the business starts, one per business type and location; home-based businesses are included.

items.title: Review applicable local licenses and permits in Missoula
items.description: Use the cited official state business resource as a starting point, then confirm city and county licensing requirements before operating.

feeDetail.note: The fee depends on the type of business and license; the city or county sets it in its fee schedule.
